name: Mary's | 200mg The Remedy Tincture | Sleep 2:1:1 THC:CBN:CBD
description: Drift into serenity with our Sleep Sublingual Oil in a luscious Black Cherry Vanilla flavor. Enriched with a blend of THC, CBN, and CBD, plus a blend of nighttime terpenes like Linalool, myrcene, and caryophyllene, this nurturing formula fosters complete body relaxation, promoting a restful night’s sleep with its intoxicating effect.
